canonical.full_scope: Durable erasure job with preserved discovery, per-object checkpoints and honest destination status; both hosts, orphans, caches/rings/seen, D1, telemetry/logs and external reconciliation. Server-enforced deletion epoch/replay barrier prevents stale-cookie and delayed/concurrent ingestion resurrection. Retention and physical progress must be tested; operator Set-Cookie alone is not a subject-browser remedy.

Persistent strict tenant/visitor ledger erasure barrier after physical rewrite, with delayed pre-cutoff queue records suppressed before R2 persistence and malformed barrier/carrier state failed closed. Stored decision-ring projection, index and in-object append/outcome retained-cutoff suppression; physical read cleanup and cross-store concurrent authority remain open.

Per-fold persisted seen membership cutoff cleanup with valid post-cutoff witnesses, legacy uncertainty and safe date/state failure behavior; historical aggregates and other erasure destinations remain open.
